Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Attaching a proposed 2-week onramp cadence so your delivery team can ramp on the Redwood runtime and integrations. High level:

- Week 1: Technical onboarding (sandbox access, model selection, API keys, integration checklist)
- Week 2: Joint runbook + pilot tickets (sample prompts, evals, rollout plan)

Can you confirm your POC and engineering leads who will join the sessions? Also indicate if you prefer two half-days or three short sessions for the technical deep dives.

Attachment: ForgeBridge_Onramp_Agenda.pdf (draft)

I copied Partners Ops to coordinate procurement and SOW. If the cadence looks good we'll send a mirrored calendar invite and the SOW template for signature.

Hi Tom —

Nice to meet you virtually. I'm Naomi, Head of Solution Enablement. We can absolutely do the three 90-minute sessions. Proposed breakdown:

- Session A (Day 1): Sandbox access, auth, and model catalog walkthrough + quick integration checklist (90 mins)
- Session B (Day 5): Prompt engineering patterns, eval harness, and basic quality monitoring (90 mins)
- Session C (Day 9): Rollout strategies, canary policies, and operational runbook + open Q&A (90 mins)

We can follow that with a 1-day train-the-trainer workshop in week 3. I'll add a short prework checklist for your engineers: network allowlists, initial dataset samples for evals, and a service account for sandbox access.

SOW and SOW template: I uploaded our standard SOW template to the shared folder and attached a clean copy for signature.
